title: Microsoft 365 Copilot saves time for teachers
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot helps teachers prepare lessons and adapt materials to individual students. In March 2026, a Microsoft case study reported that Broward County Public Schools in Florida had deployed 20,000 Copilot licenses for educators and staff. Teachers reported saving six to seven hours each week on tasks such as lesson planning. They described using the time to give students more individual attention.
